BearerAuth.description: Raw JWT token from POST /users/login. Sent verbatim with no "Bearer " prefix.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

info.description:
REST API for managing animals, enclosures and care tasks.

Only v2 routes are documented here. v1 remains served at /api/v1 for
backwards compatibility but is not part of this contract.
info.title: Animal Family API

get.description: Pass enclosureId to return only the animals in that enclosure. The enclosure must belong to the caller.

parameters.description: Only return animals in this enclosure
parameters.name: enclosureId

delete.description: Pass cascade=tasks to also delete the animal's tasks, replacing v1's separate /animal/withtasks route.
delete.summary: Delete one of the caller's animals

get.summary: Get one of the caller's animals

put.description: A full replace: every field is set to the value sent, and an omitted field is reset rather than left alone. Memorial state is not affected — use /animals/{id}/memorial for that.
put.summary: Update one of the caller's animals

delete.description: Returns a memorialised animal to the living roster, discarding its message and photos.

put.description: Records that an animal has died, along with a message, any photos, and the date. Memorialised animals are filtered out of the main views. Sending this again replaces the stored memorial.
put.summary: Memorialise one of the caller's animals

post.description: Supply animalIds to move existing animals into the new enclosure as it is created. Every animal listed must belong to the caller.

delete.description: By default only the enclosure is removed and its animals are left without one. Pass cascade=tasks to also delete the enclosure's tasks, or cascade=animals,tasks to delete its animals and their tasks as well.
delete.summary: Delete one of the caller's enclosures

get.summary: Get one of the caller's enclosures

put.summary: Update one of the caller's enclosures

get.description: Returns every habitat. Habitats are global reference data, not user-owned, so this endpoint is public.

post.description: Admin only. Fails if a habitat with the same name already exists.

put.description: Admin only. Replaces all fields of the habitat identified by the path parameter.

post.description: Delivers a test message to every subscription the caller has registered, reporting the outcome for each.

get.description: Browsers need this key to create a push subscription. It is public by design.
Returns every species. Species are global reference data, not user-owned, so this endpoint is public.

post.description: Admin only. Fails if a species with the same common or scientific name already exists.
Admin only. Uses an LLM to populate species details and generates an image, uploading it to S3. Fails if a species with that name already exists (case insensitive).

requestBody.description: Common name of the species to generate

post.summary: Generate a species from a name

put.description: Admin only. Replaces all fields of the species identified by the path parameter.

get.description: Pass animalId or enclosureId to return only the tasks attached to that subject. Supplying both is rejected.

parameters.description: Only tasks attached to this animal
parameters.name: animalId

parameters.description: Only tasks attached to this enclosure
parameters.name: enclosureId

post.description: A task belongs to exactly one subject, so supply either animalId or enclosureId. The subject must belong to the caller.

get.description: Intended for a scheduler. Resets tasks whose repeat interval has elapsed and sends their notifications in the background.
get.summary: Reset repeating tasks that are due

delete.summary: Delete one of the caller's tasks

get.summary: Get one of the caller's tasks

put.description: A full replace, also used to mark a task complete or incomplete. Supply the subject (animalId or enclosureId) on every update, not only when moving the task.
put.summary: Update one of the caller's tasks

post.description: The returned token is sent verbatim in the Authorization header, with no "Bearer " prefix.

post.summary: Issue a fresh token for the current session

servers.description: Relative to the API host, configured per environment.
